title: Rangers of Shadow Deep - Complete Campaign & Engine Data v2

format_specification.description: Algorithmic representation of scenarios, bestiary, items, companions, and campaign procedures.
format_specification.target_use_case: Game engine interpretation, Virtual Tabletop (VTT) automation, AI solo emulation.

terrain_positioning_schema.coordinate_system: Origin (0,0) is Top-Left of the table canvas. Axes: X increases eastward/right, Y increases southward/down. Units are in inches (1 foot = 12 inches).

turn_phases.description: Rangers activate in any order. Each ranger can activate up to 2 companions within 3 inches.
All enemy and neutral AI creatures activate in descending order of current Health.
Companions that did not activate in the Ranger Phase now activate.
Draw one Event Card (or as specified by scenario rules).

creature_ai_flowchart.action_true: Attack opponent. If winner, stay in combat; do not use second action.
If armed with missile weapon and in range, shoot at closest hero, then reload if crossbow. Else move full distance toward closest hero.

combat_and_damage.melee_resolution: Simultaneous d20 + Fight vs d20 + Fight. Winner scores damage = (Total Combat Score + Damage Modifiers) - Loser Armour.
combat_and_damage.critical_hits: Natural 20 on die roll automatically wins and adds +5 damage. Evil creatures cannot score critical hits.
combat_and_damage.falling_damage: Damage = floor(inches_fallen * 1.5). Falling 3 inches or less deals no damage.

missions.title: Mission 1: The Missing
missions.narrative_briefing: It has been less than a week since the destruction of Lorenthia and the appearance of the Shadow Deep. Reports of strange creatures and evil robed men flood the border. Veteran ranger Aventine went to investigate an attack on a nearby village and has not returned. You lead a team on an eight-hour trek over difficult terrain.

scenarios.title: Scenario 1: The Deserted Village
scenarios.narrative_intro: You arrive at the silent village where bodies lie in the dirt. As you reach the center to search for Aventine, a horrible moaning arises.

missions.title: Mission 2: The Beacon Tower
missions.narrative_briefing: Contact has been lost with the beacon tower of Tor Varden along the border with Lorenthia. Presumed overrun, you are commanded to proceed with all swiftness, ascertain the truth, learn what enemy forces occupy it, and eliminate or harass them.

scenarios.narrative_intro: You reach the cold and swift Enthel River. A contingent of gnolls guards the bridge and patrols the banks.

scenarios.title: Scenario 2: Tor Varden, The Lower Level
scenarios.narrative_intro: You breach Tor Varden. A muffled scream echoes from deeper inside the tower. Time is of the essence.

rooms.name: Entrance Room
rooms.setup: Contains 1 Gnoll Sergeant in contact with an unarmed captive soldier (Man-at-Arms stats, 7 Health, no shield). Two Gnoll Fighters flanking 3 inches away.
rooms.penalty_rule: If pre-scenario Stealth or Pick Lock failed (or vulture escaped in Scen 1), replace 2 Gnoll Fighters with Gnoll Sergeants.

rooms.name: The Armoury
rooms.setup: Racks of weapons. 1 Clue marker in each far corner. 1 Gnoll Archer between clue markers, 2 Gnoll Fighters in center.
rooms.penalty_rule: If Room B not opened by end of Turn 4, replace 2 Gnoll Fighters with Gnoll Sergeants.

rooms.name: The Shaman's Workshop
rooms.setup: Central table with inanimate Flesh Golem, 1 Gnoll Shaman adjacent. 2 Gnoll Fighters 3 inches from table toward door. Shaman animates Golem after 3 turns if alive.
rooms.penalty_rule: If Room C not opened in time, Shaman casts spell: entering heroes must pass Will (TN10) or suffer -2 Fight while inside.

mechanics.room_reveal_fog_of_war: Rooms B and C are only placed and populated when their connecting doors are opened.

scenarios.title: Scenario 3: Tor Varden, The Upper Level
scenarios.narrative_intro: You burst out onto the windy summit walkway of Tor Varden. The beacon pyre is prepared, a chained prisoner atop it, guarded by the dread Shadow Knight.

mechanics.falling_from_walkway: Any hero pushed over edge or moving recklessly must make Acrobatics (TN5) or fall to 0 Health. Shadow Knight automatically passes.

missions.title: Mission 3: Descent into Darkness
missions.narrative_briefing: Behind Tor Varden, you discover a massive fissure cutting down into the dark clouds of the Shadow Deep. A crude stairway descends into the abyss. Ordered to conduct the first reconnaissance expedition into enemy territory, you lead your band down the stairs.

scenarios.title: Scenario 1: The Broken Stairs
scenarios.narrative_intro: Descending the steep, cracked stairs into the choking gloom and ash, giant bloated flies emerge from gaping holes in the fissure walls.

mechanics.torch_sealing: Hero adjacent to fly hole can spend 1 action throwing torch to temporarily seal hole against card spawns.

missions.title: Campaign: Burning Light
missions.narrative_briefing: The rangers journey deep into the Shadow Deep to explore the ruined convent of St. Emilia and recover the holy healing relic, the Decanter of Burning Light. Locations can be explored non-linearly before launching the final showdown.
